main_body: Slot machine cabinet: a gold marquee at the top, a red body with a reel window showing three reels, a coin tray and slot below, and a brown base. It is drawn straight from the front.
top_band: Rows 1-4 gold (#d5b152) read as a marquee/sign panel, a vertical face, followed by a dark brown band. There is no horizontal top surface visible from above. The column at x=12 shows a 1-row highlight at row 4 and nothing else that reads as a top.
evidence: The slot machine is a straight front elevation. The gold band at the top is the marquee panel, a vertical face of the same standing front, and no foreshortened top surface is visible. The reel window, tray and slot are painted flat on the face, with no inset edges or eave shadow. The only top-like marks are a thin outline row and a 1-row highlight, which are rims and not a surface.

style.evidence: The candidate has 12 colours in total and a median of 12 per tile, against 38-40 total colours in the references and 17-20 per tile. It has no 5x5 flat fills, but the material ramps are shallow, with about 4 steps (gold, brown, red, near-black). Dark edge pixels are only 17% neutral, so the outline is partly tinted, but there are near-black areas inside, such as the reel window and the slot. Texture is limited to the reel and coin details, with little grain on the body, so it is thinner than the references.
